name: UBTECH
summary:
UBTECH develops humanoid robots and an ecosystem of hardware, AI, software and operating services. Founded in 2012, the company targets industrial, commercial and household applications, with development spanning robot bodies, actuators, perception, whole-body control and dexterous manipulation.

Its Thinker model family connects task understanding, world modeling and action generation. The company also develops simulation, training-data infrastructure and systems for coordinating multiple robots. This combination supports work ranging from an individual robot's movement to fleet-level scheduling and collaboration. UBTECH's industrial strategy emphasizes learning from production environments and using that experience to expand the tasks humanoids can perform.
